_about: Advisories CI accepts for now, each with the reason and a date to look again. scripts/check-audit.mjs fails on any other high or critical advisory, and on any entry past its review date.

advisories.reason: Denial of service through deeply nested glob patterns. Reached only through build tooling (Metro and Jest file watching via micromatch) with patterns we write ourselves; nothing in the app or the web bundle uses it. No fixed release exists (latest braces is 3.0.3; the advisory covers <= 3.0.3): checked 9 and 21 Oct 2026.

RSA signature verification flaw. Reached only through the Expo CLI's code-signing helper (@expo/code-signing-certificates), which we don't use; nothing in the app or the web bundle includes it. No fixed release exists (latest node-forge is 1.4.0; the advisory covers <= 1.4.0): checked 9 and 21 Oct 2026.

Memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections (fixed in zod 4.6.6). Reached only through the Expo CLI (@expo/cli 57.0.28 pins zod 3.25.76), which runs on the developer's computer to build the app and validates our own config; nothing in the app or the web bundle includes it. npm's only offered fix is downgrading expo to 44, which isn't one: checked 25 Oct 2026. Look again when Expo releases an @expo/cli with zod >= 4.6.6.
